expected.summary: Xiamen Everbright's sales confirmation EB-SC-261023-02 confirms the 300 stand bags of P00101 (its code EB-SB14-BK) in full, on DAP Lahti terms, but gives no delivery date to our warehouse. It gives the departure from Xiamen on 27 Oct 2026, the arrival at Helsinki port on 02 Dec 2026 and an estimate of about 3 days by truck to Lahti. A departure or a port arrival is not a delivery date, and a date computed from the port arrival and an approximate transit is not one the supplier stated, so the planned date stays 2026-12-01 and no confirmed date is recorded. The agent states that the quantity is confirmed in full (recording it as the confirmed quantity without a confirmed date is allowed). The supply chain lead gets an open item to obtain the delivery date to Lahti from the supplier, noting that the port arrival alone already falls after the requested 2026-12-01. If the agent proposes a planned or confirmed date computed from the port arrival plus the transit, the lead says no.
